name: Invoice Financing Details 1
definition: Detailed information about single invoice/instalment financing result, such as result of request (financed or not financed), amount, percentage applied.

OriginalInvoiceInformation.name: Original Invoice Information
OriginalInvoiceInformation.definition: General information that unambiguously identifies the invoice contained in the original request.

Supplier.name: Supplier
Supplier.definition: Person or organization that represents the creditor for the invoice to be financed.

InvoiceFinancingResult.name: Invoice Financing Result
InvoiceFinancingResult.definition: Information about result of invoice financing request.

InstalmentFinancingInformation.name: Instalment Financing Information
InstalmentFinancingInformation.definition: Includes details about a single instalment within an invoice, such as identification and amount.
